artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the main bookcase and the adjacent unit
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the main bookcase and the unit on the right is ambiguous. The shelves on the right seem to float or merge awkwardly with the main unit. The vertical support on the far right lacks clear grounding or connection to the base.
The perspective lines of the shelves do not perfectly converge to a single vanishing point. The bottom shelf's edge seems to warp slightly near the right corner.
The spines of the books in the middle shelf exhibit a 'smudged' or 'painted' texture rather than distinct individual physical objects. Some spines appear to fuse together.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a bookcase and not a similar storage unit, and to assess the realism of the wood texture.
To verify if the shelves have consistent depth and if the books sit correctly on them without floating or clipping through the back panel.
To detect fusion between individual book spines and check for clean boundaries between the furniture and the background/floor.
To rigorously quantify the legibility of text on book spines, a key discriminator for AI-generated images vs real photos.

focus_areas: Legibility and consistency of text on book spines
Geometric alignment of shelf edges (parallelism and perspective)
Structural integrity of the right-side extension/unit
